d = len(L)\n        th = [a for a, _, _ in L]\n        c = coords[v]\n        P = [node(c + r*np.array([math.cos(a), math.sin(a)])) for a in th]\n        for k, (_, ei, _) in enumerate(L): port[(v, ei)] = P[k]\n        if d == 2:\n            E.append((P[0], P[1], 1.0, None)); continue\n        assert d >= 3\n        pt = lambda a: c + 0.5*r*np.array([math.cos(a), math.sin(a)])\n        prevO = None\n        for k in range(1, d-1):\n            nodes = []\n            if k == 1: nodes += [P[0], P[1]]\n            else:\n                I = node(pt(th[k]-eps)); nodes += [I, P[k]]\n                seglinks.append((prevO, I))\n            if k == d-2: nodes.append(P[d-1])\n            else:\n                O = node(pt(th[k]+eps)); nodes.append(O); prevO = O\n            a, b, cc = nodes\n            E += [(a, b, 1.0, None), (b, cc, 1.0, None), (a, cc, 1.0, None)]\n    segab = {}\n    def segment(u, v, t, tag):\n        pu, pv = np.array(pos[u]), np.array(pos[v])\n        a = node(pu + (pv-pu)/3); b = node(pu + 2*(pv-pu)/3)\n        E.extend([(u, a, 1.0, None), (a, b, t, tag), (b, v, 1.0, None)])\n        return a, b\n    for (u, v) in seglinks: segment(u, v, 1.0, None)\n    for ei, (i, j, J) in enumerate(edges):\n        segab[ei] = segment(port[(i, ei)], port[(j, ei)], math.tanh(J), ei)\n    return np.array(pos), E, segab\n\ndef kasteleyn(pos, E):\n    n = len(pos)\n    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]\n    for idx, (u, v, w, _) in enumerate(E):\n        adj[u].append((v, idx)); adj[v].append((u, idx))\n    rot = {}\n    for u in range(n):\n        adj[u].sort(key=lambda x: math.atan2(*(pos[x[0]] - pos[u])[::-1]))\n        for k, (v, idx) in enumerate(adj[u]): rot[(u, v)] = k\n    # trace faces: darts\n    seen = set(); faces = []\n    for u in range(n):\n        for v, idx in adj[u]:\n            if (u, v) in seen: continue\n            f = []; a, b = u, v\n            while (a, b) not in seen:\n                seen.add((a, b)); f.append((a, b))\n                k = rot[(b, a)]\n                c = adj[b][(k - 1) % len(adj[b])][0]\n                a, b = b, c\n            faces.append(f)\n    assert n - len(E) + len(faces) == 2, (n, len(E), len(faces))\n    area = [sum(pos[a][0]*pos[b][1]-pos[b][0]*pos[a][1] for a, b in f) for f in faces]\n    sgn = np.sign(area); outer = int(np.argmin(sgn*np.sign(np.median(sgn)) * np.abs(area)))\n    assert sum(1 for s in sgn if s != np.sign(np.median(sgn))) == 1\n    # primal spanning tree\n    par = [-1]*n; orient = {}; vis = [False]*n; vis[0] = True; st = [0]\n    while st:\n        u = st.pop()\n        for v, idx in adj[u]:\n            if not vis[v]:\n                vis[v] = True; orient[idx] = (u, v); st.append(v)\n    # dual tree on remaining edges\n    edgefaces = collections.defaultdict(list)\n    for fi, f in enumerate(faces):\n        for a, b in f:\n            idx = next(i for x, i in adj[a] if x == b)  # slow-ish but ok\n            edgefaces[idx].append((fi, a, b))\n    fadj = collections.defaultdict(list)\n    for idx, lst in edgefaces.items():\n        if idx in orient: continue\n        (f1, _, _), (f2, _, _) = lst\n        fadj[f1].append((f2, idx)); st.append(g)\n    assert len(order) == len(faces)\n    for f in reversed(order):\n        if f == outer: continue\n        idx = fpar[f]; cnt = 0; dart = None\n        for a, b in faces[f]:\n            e = next(i for x, i in adj[a] if x == b)\n            if e == idx: dart = (a, b)\n            elif orient[e] == (a, b): cnt += 1\n        orient[idx] = dart if cnt % 2 == 0 else (dart[1], dart[0])\n    return orient\n\ndef setup(coords, edges):\n    pos, E, segab = build(coords, edges)\n    orient = kasteleyn(pos, E)\n    n = len(pos); Rhs[idxnodes, range(len(idxnodes))] = 1\n    Kinv = lu.solve(Rhs)[idxnodes, :]  # (K^{-1})_{II}\n    Kinv = 0.5*(Kinv - Kinv.T)\n    m = len(special)\n    corr = {}\n    for mask in range(1 << m):\n        if bin(mask).count('1') % 2: continue\n        P = set()\n        for k in range(m):\n            if mask >> k & 1: P ^= paths[k]\n        if not P: corr[mask] = 1.0; continue\n        P = sorted(P); ii = []; Cinv = np.zeros((2*len(P), 2*len(P)))\n        pref = 1.0; pfc = 1.0\n        for q, ei in enumerate(P):\n            t = math.tanh(edges[ei][2]); x = 1/t - t\n            Cinv[2*q, 2*q+1] = -1/x; Cinv[2*q+1, 2*q] = 1/x\n            pfc *= -1/x; pref *= t\n            ii += [loc[sig[ei][0]], loc[sig[ei][1]]]\n        M = Cinv + Kinv[np.ix_(ii, ii)]\n        corr[mask] = pref * pfaffian(M) / pfc\n    probs = np.zeros(1 << m)  # index bit k = 1 means spin -1 at special k\n    for mask, c in corr.items():\n        for cfg in range(1 << m):\n            pass\n    # fast Walsh transform\n    f = np.zeros(1 << m)\n    for mask, c in corr.items(): f[mask] = c\n    h = 1\n    while h < (1 << m):\n        f = f.reshape(-1, 2, h);
